objective: independenceGroup miscounts independent sources in three ways. server/services/research/standards.ts ~L191 matches syndicators with host.includes(wire), so openprocurement.org and msnbc.com are classed as wire services; ~L199's upstream-attribution regex is case-sensitive, so 'According to Gartner, ...' yields host:a.com while '..., according to Gartner.' yields upstream:gartner — one upstream estimate counted as two independent sources; and bare 'per' makes 'Costs $10 per Unit shipped' yield upstream:unit shipped. CLAUDE.md §14: three publishers restating one upstream estimate count as one. Fix: case-insensitive attribution keywords while keeping the capitalised-name capture; syndicators matched by domain equality or suffix against full domains; drop bare 'per' (or require a proper-noun organisation after it).
expectedOutcome: Upstream attribution is found regardless of keyword case, syndicators match by domain, and 'per' no longer invents an upstream.
nonGoals: Changing the evidence standards per claim type

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/researchIndependenceGroup.test.ts: both Gartner phrasings return upstream:gartner.
openprocurement.org and msnbc.com return host:…, www.prnewswire.com is still treated as a wire/release, and the 'per Unit shipped' excerpt returns its host.
Existing research gate tests pass and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
